verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents balance accounts, pooled or per-card balances, and webhooks that fire when a merchant initiates a payment and when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts. That gives some real-time visibility into money movement, and card payments can be viewed in the Customer Area. Nothing in the pack shows a ledger that links each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reports that reconcile; a 'Report' webhook type is only named, with no detail. missing for 10: authorization-to-clearing transaction linkage, settlement/reconciliation reporting documentation, real-time balance query evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: Use a single pool of funds for all card payments or maintain balances per card.
These webhooks inform you when a merchant initiates a payment, and when funds have been added to or deducted from balance accounts.
You can subscribe to the following webhooks: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report
Viewing card payments in the Customer Area
